note: Gold set for the control mapper. Each question is written the way a customer security questionnaire asks it; expected lists every control that would be an acceptable top answer. In-sample: written by the same author who tuned the ranker's synonym list (finding T-12).

items.q: Is data encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher?
Is customer data encrypted at rest?
Do you require multi-factor authentication for all employees?
How is access removed when an employee leaves the company?
Are user access rights reviewed periodically?
How are API keys and service account credentials stored and rotated?
Do you have a documented information security policy approved by management?
Who is accountable for information security in your organization?
Do you maintain a risk register and how often is it reviewed?
Has your organization defined its risk appetite?
How do you assess and monitor third-party vendors?
Do vendor contracts include breach notification requirements?
Do you maintain an inventory of your production systems and software?
How is data classified and what are the retention periods?
How do you identify vulnerabilities in third-party software components?
What is your patching SLA for critical vulnerabilities?
Do you perform backups and test restores?
Are security logs centralized and retained for at least one year?
Do you have an incident response plan and is it tested annually?
Within what timeframe will you notify us of a data breach?
Do you conduct security awareness training for staff?
How do you protect against malware on employee devices?
Do you perform penetration testing or red teaming?
Do you have a process for external researchers to report security vulnerabilities?
Do you use AI or machine learning in the service? Please describe the governance in place.
Do you maintain an inventory of AI systems and their owners?
Can the AI assistant take actions on customer accounts?
How do you prevent prompt injection attacks against your chatbot?
Are conversations with the AI assistant stored or used for training?
Does the chatbot disclose that users are interacting with an AI?
How can the AI system be disabled in an emergency?
What happens when your model provider changes the underlying model?
Are employees allowed to use public AI tools with customer data?
How do you monitor AI output quality and harmful responses?
Do you test AI systems with adversarial inputs before release?
What is the escalation process for an AI-related incident?
How do you rate limit and prevent abuse of public APIs?
Are secrets ever stored in source code repositories?
Do you use a Content Security Policy and other browser security headers?
Is there a change management process with testing before deployment?
How do you handle exceptions to security policies?
Do you perform post-incident reviews with root cause analysis?
Do you have a business continuity and disaster recovery plan with defined RTO and RPO?
How are customers informed during an outage?
Do you monitor your security posture continuously rather than through an annual audit?
How are security alerts triaged and by whom?
Which laws and regulations apply to your service and how do you track them?
Which cybersecurity framework has your organization adopted?
What criteria define a security incident and who can declare one?
How do findings from audits and tests get tracked to closure?
